title: Swastika Infra IPO Details
intro:
Swastika Infra IPO is a book build issue of ₹160.87 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 69.46 lakh shares aggregating to ₹128.50 crores and offer for sale of 17.50 lakh shares aggregating to ₹32.38 crores.

Swastika Infra IPO opens for subscription on Sep 23, 2026 and closes on Sep 25, 2026. The allotment for the Swastika Infra IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 28, 2026. Swastika Infra IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 30, 2026.

Swastika Infra IPO is set issue price band at ₹175 to ₹185 per share. The lot size for an application is 81 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,985 (81 shares) (based on upper price).

Srujan Alpha Capital Advisors LLP is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Swastika Infra IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

Updated on Sep 18, 2026 Incorporated in August 2019, Swastika Infra Limited is an Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company specializing in power distribution infrastructure projects (EPC Power Projects) and the sale of electrical products. Business Verticals: EPC Power Projects: The company provides end-to-end turnkey solutions covering procurement, supply, erection, installation, testing, and commissioning of power infrastructure. The scope of work includes: Underground cabling work – Laying, installation, and commissioning of high-voltage/low-voltage power cables to enhance efficiency and reduce power losses. Construction of substations – Execution of Gas Insulated Substations (GIS) and Air Insulated Substations (AIS), including installation of power transformers, circuit breakers, and ring main units. Rural and urban electrification projects – Expanding electricity access in underserved regions by implementing distribution networks, service connections, and feeder lines under government schemes. Installation of street lighting systems – Enhancing urban and rural infrastructure through public lighting projects. Sale of Products: The company is engaged in the trading of electrical products, including the procurement and sale of power cables and other electrical items. While the primary focus is on EPC projects, this segment remains part of its operations. Projects & Presence: Completed Projects: Since 2012, the company has completed 34 EPC Power Projects across four Indian states, covering 8,519.50 circuit kilometres (CKM) with a total contract value of ₹60,410 Lakhs. Ongoing Projects: As of February 28, 2025, The company has 12 ongoing EPC Power Projects across five Indian states with an aggregate order value of Rs 1,47,815 Lakhs. Notable Projects: System Strengthening Works of Jaipur JCC Circle under Jaipur Discom in Rajasthan. Supply contract for rural electrification work in Dausa District. Rural electrification works in Sikar under Ajmer Discom, Rajasthan. Supply, erection, testing & commissioning of SCADA-compatible equipment in Jaipur City Circle (Divisions III, IV, and V). faqs.question: How to apply in Swastika Infra IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Swastika Infra IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Swastika Infra IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Swastika Infra IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Swastika Infra IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Swastika Infra IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Swastika Infra IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
